name: Times club monthly special crossword No 20,245

solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Escape home beset by delay, very good for losing temperature

indicators.note: something beset by others is surrounded on all sides, so those words go round it

blocks.note: to defer is to delay
standard abbreviation for very
the Escape key on a keyboard is labelled Esc
at home means in
standard abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: Someone running a fever escapes home only after a delay and feels much better as it breaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very good' looks like one phrase of praise, but its two words split to sit either side of the inserted pair. Esc is the keyboard key.
explanation.definitionFit: Defervescence is the medical term for a fever subsiding, so a patient in that state is cooling down from a raised body heat.

clue.text: Happens to break down before antivirus finally turns back on

indicators.note: one word breaking into another splits it open and sits inside
finally points to the closing letter of the word it follows

blocks.note: taken as written, opened up around the next piece
something that is, or takes place, happens
the last letter of antivirus

explanation.surface: A computer breaks down until the antivirus software finally switches back on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turns back on' looks like rebooting the machine, but it means rejects.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn your back on someone is to refuse any further connection with them, which is exactly what renouncing a relative involves.

clue.text: Glib speculation mounted after voting system elected to power the clear leader

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounted means climbing upwards, so the word is read from bottom to top

blocks.note: a facile remark is glib and superficial
PR is proportional representation
a party elected to power is in
spec is short for speculation, as in buying on spec

explanation.surface: A smooth politician's rise to the top after a new electoral system is introduced is the subject of easy speculation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' fixes the order: the upturned piece follows the voting system and the elected party. The answer is Latin for 'easily first'.
explanation.definitionFit: Facile princeps is a Latin tag meaning easily first, used of someone who is unquestionably the foremost in a group.

clue.text: Current member of Ukip, very quiet going over healing process?

indicators.note: going means departing, so the words before it leave the piece they belong to
turned over, the letters in a down clue are read from bottom to top

blocks.note: I is the symbol for electric current
kipper is a slang name for a supporter of the UK Independence Party
pianissimo, the musical marking for very quiet

explanation.surface: A Ukip supporter who has gone very quiet is apparently going through some therapy.
explanation.walkthrough: KIPPER loses PP to give KIER; I+KIER then turns over. Ukip is a British right-wing party whose members are nicknamed kippers.
explanation.definitionFit: Reiki is a Japanese alternative therapy in which practitioners claim to channel energy through their hands; the question mark flags its doubtful status.

clue.text: Bomber with unknown range not accompanied skyward

indicators.note: heading skyward in a down clue means the letters rise, read from bottom to top

blocks.note: y is a standard algebraic unknown
an Aga is a brand of cooking range
lone means solitary

explanation.surface: A bomber flying with an unknown range heads up into the sky without an escort.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a heavy cast-iron British kitchen stove, a kind of range. Y+AGA+LONE is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Enola Gay was the B-29 aircraft that dropped the atomic bomb on Hiroshima in 1945.

clue.text: Run through fourth section of book

blocks.note: ch is the abbreviation for chapter
IV is the Roman numeral for four

explanation.surface: A reader skims quickly through the fourth part of a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run through' looks like skimming the chapter, but it means to stab. CH IV is how chapter four is labelled.
explanation.definitionFit: Chiv is slang for a knife and, as a verb, to stab someone, piercing them with a blade.

clue.text: Ascendant among trichinae, tremendously flat worm

indicators.note: ascendant means rising, so in a down clue the letters climb and read upwards
among says the answer is found inside the words that follow

blocks.note: the end of trichinae joined to the start of tremendously

explanation.surface: One parasite stands out among the trichina worms by being remarkably flat.
explanation.walkthrough: Trichinae are parasitic roundworms, which makes 'worm' look like part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemerteans are ribbon worms, a phylum of soft, flattened, unsegmented marine invertebrates.

clue.text: Basis for judiciary process aided direction

indicators.note: to process material is to work it over, so these letters are worked into a new order

blocks.note: fourteen letters taken as fodder

explanation.surface: A court process was helped along by clear guidance from the judge.
explanation.definitionFit: The ratio decidendi is the legal reasoning on which a court's decision rests, the principle that binds later judges.

clue.text: With shudders, seeing that cod-like fish

blocks.note: as means since, seeing that
the hake is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Someone trembles at the sight of an unappetising fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashake is a literary adjective meaning trembling or quivering all over.

clue.text: Preparation of cabbage in sandwich of fish and chips?

indicators.note: the sandwich is the outside bread only, leaving out the filling word between the two nouns

blocks.note: the end of fish, the middle word, and the start of chips

explanation.surface: A cabbage dish served in a fish-and-chip sandwich sounds like a strange chip-shop special.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the middle word, the letters either side of it in 'fish and chips' join up as SH+CHI.
explanation.definitionFit: Shchi is a traditional Russian soup made chiefly from cabbage, so it is a dish prepared from that vegetable.

clue.text: Rowers having scored more marks when initially entering contests that China lost

indicators.note: pieces entering another word go inside it
initially points to the opening letter of the word beside it

blocks.note: oars are rowers in the sense of people rowing a boat
più is Italian for more, a marking found in musical scores
M is the abbreviation for marks, the old German currency
the first letter of when

explanation.surface: A crew of rowers outscores its rivals in a series of races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scored' hints at a musical score, the clue that the Italian word for more is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: The nineteenth-century Opium Wars were conflicts in which Britain defeated Qing China over the drug trade.

clue.text: Tumult of WWII represented with wall

indicators.note: represented means presented afresh in a different form, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken letter by letter
taken as written

explanation.surface: A wall mural depicts the turmoil of the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: A williwaw is a sudden violent squall, and by extension any state of commotion or uproar.

clue.text: Plant yielding fibre and an acidic fruit, mostly from the east

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the word loses its last letter
in an across clue, coming from the east means reading right to left

blocks.note: the indefinite article
citrus fruits are sharply acidic

explanation.surface: A botanist lists a fibre-producing plant alongside a sour fruit imported from Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Urtica is the nettle genus, and nettle stems have long been retted for a strong textile fibre.

clue.text: Among leaders in Soviet Union with a vote, Molotov now is extremely secure

indicators.note: leaders are the opening letters of the words that follow
something among others is placed in their midst

blocks.note: the first letters of Soviet and Union
the Russian city of Perm was called Molotov from 1940 to 1957
taken as written
a voter marks a cross on the ballot

explanation.surface: A Soviet minister, voting among the leadership, is utterly safe in his position.
explanation.walkthrough: Molotov looks like the Soviet foreign minister, but here it is the old name of a Russian city.
explanation.definitionFit: A supermax prison is a maximum-security jail, the most tightly guarded kind of penal institution.

clue.text: Attended to part of house, one under roof with bad joints

indicators.note: something attended to has been listened to, so we want how these words are heard

blocks.note: a room is part of a house
the attic is the room right under the roof

explanation.surface: A builder saw to a room in the house and the loft, but now has aching knees.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, ROOM ATTIC gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheumatic describes someone suffering from rheumatism, the painful inflammation and stiffness of muscles and joints.

clue.text: Nurse with touching affection

blocks.note: to tend the sick is to nurse them
re means concerning, touching on

explanation.surface: A nurse cares for patients with tender, moving fondness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching' looks like an adjective describing the affection, but it means about.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendre, borrowed from French, is a fond feeling or soft spot for someone.

clue.text: Primate immersed in clear liquid in place of worship

indicators.note: something immersed in a liquid sits wholly inside it

blocks.note: serum is the clear fluid part of blood
an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: A specimen monkey is preserved in a jar of clear fluid inside a temple.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Primate' suggests an archbishop, which fits the church setting, but here it is an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Serapeum is a temple dedicated to the Graeco-Egyptian god Serapis, the most famous being in Alexandria.

clue.text: See first person bound by God’s contrary instruction to follow

indicators.note: something bound by another is held inside it
contrary means going the opposite way, so the letters run backwards

blocks.note: Zeus is chief of the Greek gods
v is short for vide, Latin for see
I is the first-person pronoun

explanation.surface: A worshipper is told to look first to a contrary deity's command and obey.
explanation.walkthrough: V and I go inside ZEUS, making ZE(VI)US, which then reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Suivez is French for follow, a musical direction telling the accompanist to keep with the soloist.

clue.text: Indian longs to have time away from firm, twice …

indicators.note: having something away from a word means it is taken out of that word
twice says the removal is made at both places the letter appears

blocks.note: stalwart means firm and steadfast
standard abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: An Indian person yearns for time off from the company, twice over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Longs' looks like a verb of yearning, but it is a plural noun for long trousers. Both Ts leave STALWART.
explanation.definitionFit: Salwar are loose trousers worn in South Asia, typically under a kameez, so they are long garments for the legs.

clue.text: Former concerns holding back extreme reactionaries

indicators.note: back says the word reads from right to left
holding means having something held within

blocks.note: reck is an archaic verb meaning to care or concern oneself
the extreme of something is its end

explanation.surface: Old worries keep extremist right-wingers from advancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Former' marks the archaic verb reck, to care; 'extreme' reads as an adjective but is a noun here.
explanation.definitionFit: Redneck is a derogatory term for a conservative, often rural, white American with reactionary politics.

clue.text: … for her hen party, raising drinks around, say, noon

indicators.note: around means surrounding the words that follow
raising in a down clue lifts the letters so they read upwards

blocks.note: cups of tea are drinks
e.g. means for example, say
standard abbreviation for noon

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, an Indian bride has a hen party where drinks are raised around midday.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis carries 'Indian' over from 17 down. A hen party is a British bachelorette party. TE(EGN)AS reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A sangeet is a pre-wedding musical celebration in Indian tradition, largely a gathering of the bride's female relatives and friends.

clue.text: I once was privileged to take two of every seven in lunar excursion modules

definitions.note: the answer speaks as the person, so this stands for an old noble

indicators.text: take two of every seven in
indicators.note: taking a fixed pair from each run of seven picks letters at a regular interval

blocks.note: letters 1-2, 8-9 and 15-16

explanation.surface: An astronaut recalls the privilege of riding in Apollo landing craft.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is written in the first person, as the answer describing itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A lucumo was an Etruscan prince or priest-king, a member of the ancient ruling class with special rank.

clue.text: Rada’s rival for drama in conspiracy theory writer’s case

indicators.note: for here means in place of, so one piece is swapped out for another

blocks.note: QAnon is a far-right American conspiracy theory
Noh, also spelt No, is classical Japanese drama
RADA and LAMDA are rival London drama schools

explanation.surface: One drama school competes with another for a part in a conspiracy thriller.
explanation.walkthrough: RADA and LAMDA are well-known London acting academies; the drama wanted is the Japanese kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A qalamdan is a Persian lacquered pen box, a container in which scribes kept their reed pens.

clue.text: Beaky one informally detained by officer’s assistant

indicators.note: something detained by another is held inside it

blocks.note: ADC is an aide-de-camp, an officer's assistant
'un is a casual way of saying one

explanation.surface: A beaky-nosed character is held by an officer's aide.
explanation.definitionFit: Adunc means hooked or curved inwards, the shape of a parrot's or hawk's bill.

clue.text: Novel by a contemporary of Hemingway (“Papa”) and another American author

definitions.text: Novel by a contemporary of Hemingway

blocks.note: Papa is the NATO alphabet word for P
Anaïs Nin was an American diarist and novelist

explanation.surface: A book written by one of Hemingway's peers, with the man himself and a fellow American author.
explanation.walkthrough: Papa was Hemingway's nickname, which hides its role as the letter P.
explanation.definitionFit: Pnin is a 1957 comic novel by Vladimir Nabokov, who was writing at the same time as Hemingway.

clue.text: Natural desire to criticise false claim, ousting each Republican

indicators.note: ousting means throwing out, and each says every such letter goes, not just one

blocks.note: to rap is to rebuke or criticise
a pretence is a false claim
standard abbreviation for Republican

explanation.surface: Attacking a bogus claim and expelling every Republican comes as a natural urge to some.
explanation.walkthrough: Both Rs, one in RAP and one in PRETENCE, go.
explanation.definitionFit: Appetence is a craving or instinctive longing, the same root as appetite.

clue.text: Not taking sides, Enterprise captain’s first name recalled is “Bones”

indicators.note: without its sides, a word loses its outermost letters
recalled means called back, so the letters run backwards

blocks.note: Jean-Luc Picard captained the starship Enterprise in Star Trek

explanation.surface: A neutral Star Trek fan remembers that the Enterprise's doctor is nicknamed Bones.
explanation.walkthrough: Bones is the nickname of the Enterprise's doctor, McCoy, a false trail in this setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulnae is the plural of ulna, the inner of the two long bones in the human forearm.

clue.text: I’m in cahoots with church’s foremost reforming religious campaigner

indicators.note: foremost picks out the leading letter of the word
reforming means forming again in a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken letter by letter
the opening letter of church

explanation.surface: A conspirator confesses to colluding with church leaders in a reform movement.
explanation.definitionFit: An iconomachist is someone who opposes the use of images in worship, campaigning against icons on religious grounds.
